changes.text: Removed Blizzard/WoW API entirely — Raider.IO is now the sole sync source
Raider.IO URL field on character registration — auto-fills class, spec, item level, realm, and portrait
Sync All button on Guild Roster — re-syncs every character from Raider.IO at once, skipping errors
Per-character Sync button on Guild Roster for quick individual re-syncs
Character portrait (thumbnail) pulled from Raider.IO and stored on registration and sync
Characters with alt-code / unicode names (e.g. Ñight, Ðëáth) now sync correctly
Registration channel management — bot auto-posts a pinned 'Start Here' embed and deletes non-bot messages
Admin Registration Log page showing every character register/delete event with source and timestamp
Guild Roster now accessible to both Officers and Raid Leaders
Roster errors now display the actual failure reason instead of silently showing nothing
Dashboard banner prompting users with no characters to register
Changelog system — this page and the /changelog Discord command
Fixed slash commands not syncing to new guilds on bot join
Fixed auto-archive loop crashing when a channel had been deleted
Reminder loop now cleans up previously-posted reminder messages before sending a new one
Attendance page showing per-member raid participation percentages
Officer attendance export
Event embeds now show attendance count in real time
Discord bot with slash commands for character management, raid events, and signups
Web portal with Discord OAuth login
Raid event creation, signup embeds, and automatic reminders
Guild roster view for officers
Role-based access: member, raid_leader, officer
